subtitle: Mission Architect & Assistant Positioning Refinement — Pre-8.0

Created Mission Architect inside both the compact and full-page assistant with six guided goals and 24 structured actions.
Every generated action plan provides practical explanations and studio links for talents, equipment, progression, accounts, farming and developer testing.
Added manual Copy Plan and Export Plan controls without modifying existing character plans, Battle.net sessions or local progress.
Retained the v7.9.8 contextual assistant, 27 supported answer topics, Founder bubble, Hyper Music, and all v7.9.6 progression reports.
Updated PC/mobile guides, device and player-testing checklists, public release center, Gateway metadata, regression tests and gated Discord draft.
